holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.description: Smite a foe with radiant light.

sheltering_veil.name: Sheltering Veil
sheltering_veil.description: Ward yourself against the elements for 3 turns.
sheltering_veil.action_string:
BUFF SELF fire_resistance 30 3_TURNS
BUFF SELF ice_resistance 30 3_TURNS
BUFF SELF lightning_resistance 30 3_TURNS
BUFF SELF wind_resistance 30 3_TURNS
BUFF SELF light_resistance 30 3_TURNS
BUFF SELF dark_resistance 30 3_TURNS

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurl a ball of fire at one foe.

icicle.name: Icicle
icicle.description: Impale one foe on a spike of ice.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.description: Call lightning down on one foe.

tradewinds.name: Tradewinds
tradewinds.description: Batter a foe with a gale.

night_ode.name: Night Ode
night_ode.description: A mournful song that wounds one foe.

moonlight_waltz.name: Moonlight Waltz
moonlight_waltz.description: A dance of shadow over every foe.

e_inferno.name: Gathering Inferno
e_inferno.action_string:
SET SELF charging true 1_TURN
DELAY NONBLOCKING TURNS 1 IF SELF EXISTS_VARIABLE charging DAMAGE ALL_ENEMIES 2.0*INT FIRE
